dogecoin.text: Some thoughts on how to respond when asked about #dogecoin. Hopefully some of the people buying #doge stick around to learn some things about #Bitcoin #Litecoin and what #Decentralization is all about. https://t.co/HWmrh10JDm

We need to let these guys know that people don’t actually use #dogecoin to pay for things, they use #Litecoin.  If you doubt me just ask most #doge holders if they can do a transaction on the network. #PayWithLitecoin

Will #Dogecoin or #Litecoin emerge as the future currency of Earth?? My guess is it will be #LTC as #Bitcoin  has clearly been established as #DigitalGold. #LitecoinTo1k will be only be the start of adoption as many new payment networks will allow us to #PayWithLitecoin https://t.co/hD4WjIu1Cf

Notice how #Litecoin helps to secure the #dogecoin network. #LTC has more going on than most people realize and the network security plus low fees make it the most trusted and reliable Blockchain to use for transferring real world value. #PayWithLitecoin #LitecoinTo1k

Interesting… Most people don’t realize that #Litecoin helps to secure the #dogecoin network through merge mining. Are #scrypt coins the answer for transactions and payments?? #LitecoinTo1k may bring in a waive of new users that may be ready to #PayWithLitecoin

#Dogecoin has a market cap 6 times greater than #Litecoin but…. the $LTC network clearly gets more use. One coin definitely looks undervalued compared to the other. Nothing against #Doge but I am just pointing out the obvious. https://t.co/HBY1FXwT2M

Don’t confuse memecoins with real cryptocurrencies. Real cryptos like #Bitcoin #Litecoin are commodities and have a cost of production. #Dogecoin is a legit #memecoin but remember… if your crypto has No cost of production then it’s fake.
It shows how screwed up the crypto market is when #Dogecoin has a market cap that is more than 3 times the size of #Litecoin. Way more transactions and use actually happens on $LTC.

What’s good for #Dogecoin mining is of course good for #Litecoin mining. Mining Doge/LTC is more profitable than mining $BTC so I would expect the mining industry to gravitate towards Doge/LTC mining.
